description: bash init.sh brings the demo-mode dev server up from cold on the project's own port (build/ports.json) and --stop tears it down.
verification: bash init.sh >/dev/null && curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://localhost:$(jq -r .dev build/ports.json)/ && bash init.sh --stop >/dev/null

description: Executable layer rules: domain stays pure, fetch() only in the API client, UI depends on ports not adapters, no AWS SDK or VITE_ secrets in the browser bundle, backend reuses the rules engine.
The PreToolUse guard blocks merges, protected-branch pushes, force pushes, gate bypasses, deploys (incl. sam/aws) and shell-wrapper evasions while allowing benign look-alikes.
quality-sweep.sh exits zero: architecture, config integrity, registry re-verification, debug artifacts, doc validity, secrets, guardrails, dead exports.
Layer 3: main requires review, required check 'build-and-test', and admins cannot bypass (run harden-github.sh after the first push).
verification: gh api repos/$(git remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#.*github\.com[:/]([^/]+/[^/.]+)(\.git)?#\1#')/branches/main/protection | jq -e '.enforce_admins.enabled == true and .required_pull_request_reviews.required_approving_review_count >= 1'

description: ESLint (typescript-eslint, react-hooks, react-refresh, jsx-a11y) reports zero problems.
TypeScript strict mode passes for the app, node tooling and backend projects.
All vitest suites pass: domain rules, import, config, components, backend routes/images/sync, base path, static server.
knip reports no unused files, exports or dependencies (tailwindcss is CSS-imported and allowlisted).
A win consumes no life.

description: A loss consumes exactly one life.
verification: npx vitest run src/domain/rules/engine.test.ts -t 'a loss consumes exactly one life'

description: A tie consumes exactly one life (configurable per league).
verification: npx vitest run src/domain/rules/engine.test.ts -t 'a tie consumes exactly one life'

description: The third miss eliminates the player in that week; later weeks cannot add strikes.
verification: npx vitest run src/domain/rules/engine.test.ts -t 'third miss eliminates'

description: A team used earlier in the season cannot be picked again; the check runs in the domain and again on the API.
verification: npx vitest run src/domain/rules/picks.test.ts backend/src/routes/routes.test.ts -t 'already used'

description: Different players may use the same team in the same week.
verification: npx vitest run src/domain/rules/engine.test.ts -t 'different players may use the same team'

description: A pick cannot change once its game kicked off, but can change right up to kickoff.
A team on bye cannot be selected.
verification: npx vitest run src/domain/rules/picks.test.ts -t 'rejects a team on bye'

description: No pick is pending while the week is open and a miss once the last game kicks off; weeks without schedule data never strike anyone.
Re-applying the same result observation is a no-op; corrections bump the version once; commissioner results lock against provider overwrites.
A commissioner result override recalculates lives, eliminations and champions from scratch.
Everyone out in the same week yields co-champions by default or tied finalists pending a recorded commissioner decision.
verification: npx vitest run src/domain/rules/engine.test.ts -t 'eliminated in the same week'

description: Cancelled games void the pick (or count as a miss per settings) and return the team; postponed games stay pending.
Other players' picks are hidden until kickoff; own picks and the commissioner's view are never redacted (domain + API).
The API re-validates deadlines (server clock), team reuse, eliminations and roles on every pick; writes are version-conditional (409 on races).
The ESPN scoreboard parser maps events to provider-independent games (skipping unknown teams); commissioners can enter schedules/results manually when the provider is down (503 surfaced).
Both Lambda handlers bundle with esbuild (AWS SDK external).
verification: node backend/build.mjs && test -f backend/dist/api/index.mjs && test -f backend/dist/syncResults/index.mjs

description: A valid JPG/PNG/WebP under 5 MB gets presigned POSTs and finalizes after the API verifies both objects.
Unsupported types (gif, svg) and oversized/empty images are rejected before a ticket is issued and again at finalize (object deleted).
Replacing a headshot deletes the previous objects; removing restores the default avatar.
Players without a headshot, or whose image fails to load, show the default avatar with meaningful alt text.
The Vite base is derived from VITE_BASE_PATH or GITHUB_REPOSITORY and never assumed to be '/'; user/org sites resolve to '/'.
npm run build emits a static site (index.html, base-aware 404.html, .nojekyll, hashed assets) deployable directly to GitHub Pages.
verification: npx vite build --base=/Survivor/ --outDir dist-e2e >/dev/null && test -f dist-e2e/index.html && grep -q "var base = '/Survivor/'" dist-e2e/404.html && test -f dist-e2e/.nojekyll && grep -q '/Survivor/assets/' dist-e2e/index.html

description: scripts/serve-static.mjs behaves like GitHub Pages (base-only serving, 301 on bare repo path, real 404 with 404.html, no SPA rewrite).
Under /Survivor/: boots with zero 404s, nested-route refresh keeps the page, clean deep links are rewritten by 404.html, unknown routes render Not Found.
Demo mode runs entirely from static files: league home, sign-in, make/change pick, locked picks, grid, my-season, mobile navigation.
Commissioner adds players, corrects results (standings recalculate), imports CSV with a blocking report, sets picks after kickoff, moves the demo clock; non-commissioners are redirected.
axe-core reports no WCAG 2.x A/AA violations on the ten primary screens, desktop and mobile.
The synthetic demo season regenerates byte-identically (seeded PRNG) and is flagged isSynthetic.
verification: cp src/data/demo/fixtures/demo-season.json node_modules/.tmp/fixture.before.json && npm run -s fixtures:generate >/dev/null && cmp -s node_modules/.tmp/fixture.before.json src/data/demo/fixtures/demo-season.json && jq -e '.season.isSynthetic==true' src/data/demo/fixtures/demo-season.json >/dev/null

description: Sample headshots (SVG placeholders) and a default avatar ship as static assets for demo mode.
verification: test -f public/headshots/default.svg && test "$(ls public/headshots/*.svg | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -ge 10

description: The CSV import CLI validates a players×weeks sheet against the schedule and rules and writes a Markdown report (ambiguous teams, reuse, missing picks, byes, loss markers).
verification: npm run -s import:report -- data/import/sample-league.csv --out node_modules/.tmp/report.md >/dev/null && npx vitest run src/domain/import --reporter=dot

description: Seed the real league from the commissioner's picks. data/import/league.csv now holds week 1 (9 players, supplied in chat, not from the screenshot — that was never attached). The CSV parses clean, but 0 of 9 picks are committable until those 9 people are league members: the demo fixture still has the fictional sample cast. Add them (Commissioner -> Players, or reseed) then import.
verification: test -f data/import/league.csv && npm run -s import:report -- data/import/league.csv --out docs/import-report.generated.md

description: CI (pull_request + push) and Pages deploy workflows parse; the deploy job is pinned to refs/heads/main and the CI job is named build-and-test for branch protection.
The SAM template parses as YAML and declares the table, bucket, Cognito pool, HTTP API with JWT authorizer, API + sync functions and the schedule.
